additional_info.body:
Hello Markus﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002028
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
KbapdX
Problem Description
: DC3 outlet was not able to charge multiple times.
Troubleshooting
:
After yesterday's site visit, we performed some tests to understand what was wrong with with Plug DC3.
We started by measuring CP and PP:
CP voltage was around 12V when measured without EV plugged in. → Correct
Then we measured the PP for continuity and voltage in XD211
When we had the EV connected in DC3 we only measured 0V in PP
Comparing with DC4, when we measured it was ~3.7V
The continuity could't be measured in the PP
In the logs, we can see that the session doesn't even go to P00_Unknown → P01_Authentication and stops with the error:
PLC link
no
SLAC or PLC link
As such, it must be a broken contact inside the cable and needs replacement.
After we perform the replacement the DC3 is able to charge again.
Provide me the service report and help me fill in this information
Defective part name/MLFB: CCS2 cable
Component serial number:
Logs with marked error (CSV format preferred):
[DCC] DC3: PilotState "A" --> "B2" → session start
Active error flags before replacement: No error flags
Device-specific error code
(if applicable):
PLC link
no
SLAC or PLC link
Outcome of wiring checkup: CP voltage is 12V but PP is 0V with EV plugged in:
For DC3
For DC4
As per the standards:

Commissioning date

(see side note):

Signs of corrosion (external): No
Evidence of water ingress: No
Outlet Number and position (e.g. DC1 - Left): DC3
Cable lifetime from commissioning until replacement:

, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
